title: b64_input_was_limited detection iterates CRLF-filtered bytes twice
description: decode.rs lines 58-72: stripping CR/LF uses one .filter().take().collect() pass, then a second .filter().nth(max_b64_chars).is_some() pass over body_bytes to detect whether truncation occurred. For bodies larger than max_bytes this performs O(2n) work over the same slice. A single pass that counts filtered bytes while collecting would eliminate the second traversal. Impact: only relevant for large base64 bodies with a small max_bytes preview — common in mail preview scenarios. Not O(n^2) but wastes cache bandwidth on large messages.
close_reason: Fixed: single-pass loop in decode.rs replaces the two separate filter passes
